it_paver.title_original: Tipologie travi da ponte (Paver Via 2021, travi da ponte)

locators.HP: it_paver PDF p3 (printed 25) = it_hp125 p1: 'HP 125 - SEZIONE FILANTE', table TIPO HP100, H 100, B 125, C 125 cm
locators.UHP: it_uhp250 p1 = it_paver p4 (printed 26): 'UHP 250 - SEZIONE FILANTE'; sketches at H 170, 80 (C 250) and UHP60 (C 114,4); tables H, B(max), C(max), C(min)
locators.VHP: it_paver p5 (printed 27): 'VHP 250 - TRAVE FILANTE'; sketches at H 170 and 80, B 97,4 (table 97), C 250
locators.HTP: it_paver p6 (printed 28) = it_htp p1: HTP60/50/40, B 60, C(max) 150, C(min) 60
locators.IHP_THP: it_paver p7 (printed 29): 'IMPALCATI A TRAVI ACCOSTATE' IHP (B = C = 60) and THP (B 60, C 18)

method: Image-only pages rendered at 300 dpi; the grey-filled sketch was masked, mirror-symmetrised and simplified, scaled by the printed widths and depth (the UHP/VHP/HP/IHP sketches are to scale: independent x and y scales agree within 0.4-1.5%). Corner coordinates were then read and rounded to 5 mm; for the U/V families the webs are straight lines common to the H 170 and H 80 sketches, so intermediate depths only extend the webs.
geometry_notes: Only H, B and C (overall widths) are printed; all thicknesses are scaled from the sketches: ESTIMATE (typ. +/-10-20 mm).

UHP/VHP (open U/V troughs): web lines x = 522 + 0.1532 (y - y0) (outer; y0 = 271 VHP, 253 UHP) and x = 375 + 0.1488 (y - 289) (inner); top flange: web top at H - 202, haunch slope 0.515 to the flange underside y = H - 81 + 0.049 (x - 938), tip 1250/H - 62. Bottom slab 214 mm at the centre, 238 at the inner fillet. Reproduces the H 80 sketch within ~25 mm.
UHP modelled at C(max) = B(max) = 2500; the table also lists C(min) 147/144/138/132/126/120 (narrower top flanges) which is not modelled.
UHP60: sketch prints 114,4 top width, table 114 (conflict preserved); modelled 1144, no top flange.
VHP bottom width: sketch 97,4 vs table 97 cm; 974 mm used.
HP100: heading 'HP 125' vs table 'HP100' (H 100, B = C = 125); implemented as HP100. Web scales to 150 mm.

HTP: C varies 60-150 cm; implemented at C(max) = 150 cm. The sketch is drawn with a ~120 cm flange although labelled 150; flange thickness (tip 78, root 90 mm) and 15 mm soffit chamfers scaled via the 60 cm stem.
IHP: sketch is to scale at H ~ 65 cm (IHP65); other depths change the web only. IHP120/125/130/135/140 rows print H 90/85/80/75/70 (designation/depth conflict) and are NOT implemented.
THP: printed C = 18 cm stem is used (sketch scales to ~20 cm); bottom flange scaled.
SOLAIO BOX (voided slab, H 25-60) not implemented: void sizes not scalable with confidence.

IHP._columns: H, B, C cm (IHP120-140 conflicting, not implemented)

trace_check._note: model area vs area of the traced (scaled, symmetrised) sketch; symmetric-difference / area in brackets
